accounts.name: poolStateV1
docs: Legacy pool state layout stored at the poolState PDA before migration.

accounts.name: poolStateV2
docs: Current pool state layout stored at the poolState PDA.

accounts.name: rebalanceRecord
docs: Transient PDA account used between startRebalance and endRebalance.

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

instructions.name: syncSolValue
docs: After calcProgram, pass the selected SOL value calculator CPI accounts as remaining accounts.
The accounts the SOL value calculator program named before them takes.

display.interpolatedIntent: Updates the SOL value the Infinity pool records for ${accounts.lstMint}

instructions.name: swapExactIn
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: inpCalcProgram, inp calculator CPI accounts, outCalcProgram, out calculator CPI accounts, pricingProgram, pricing CPI accounts.

The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the input LST's SOL value calculator accounts (as many as inpLstValueCalcAccs counts, less the program before them), the output LST's SOL value calculator program and its accounts (outLstValueCalcAccs counts both), then the pool's pricing program and its accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} swaps ${data.amount} of ${accounts.inpLstMint} from ${accounts.inpLstAcc} for at least ${data.limit} of ${accounts.outLstMint} to ${accounts.outLstAcc} through the Infinity pool

instructions.name: swapExactOut
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: inpCalcProgram, inp calculator CPI accounts, outCalcProgram, out calculator CPI accounts, pricingProgram, pricing CPI accounts.

The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the input LST's SOL value calculator accounts (as many as inpLstValueCalcAccs counts, less the program before them), the output LST's SOL value calculator program and its accounts (outLstValueCalcAccs counts both), then the pool's pricing program and its accounts.

display.intent: Swap for an exact amount out
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} swaps at most ${data.limit} of ${accounts.inpLstMint} from ${accounts.inpLstAcc} for ${data.amount} of ${accounts.outLstMint} to ${accounts.outLstAcc} through the Infinity pool

instructions.name: addLiquidity
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: inpCalcProgram, input LST calculator CPI accounts, pricingProgram, pricing CPI accounts.
The output side is the INF LP mint.
The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the LST's SOL value calculator accounts (lstValueCalcAccs counts them with the program before them), then the pool's pricing program and its accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} deposits ${data.amount} of ${accounts.lstMint} from ${accounts.lstAcc} into the Infinity pool for at least ${data.minOut} of ${accounts.lpTokenMint} to ${accounts.lpAcc}

instructions.name: removeLiquidity
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: outCalcProgram, output LST calculator CPI accounts, pricingProgram, pricing CPI accounts.
The input side is the INF LP mint.
The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the LST's SOL value calculator accounts (lstValueCalcAccs counts them with the program before them), then the pool's pricing program and its accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} burns ${data.amount} of ${accounts.lpTokenMint} from ${accounts.lpAcc} to withdraw at least ${data.minOut} of ${accounts.lstMint} from the Infinity pool to ${accounts.lstAcc}
${accounts.admin} stops the Infinity pool from taking ${accounts.lstMint} in
${accounts.admin} lets the Infinity pool take ${accounts.lstMint} in again

display.intent: Add an LST to the pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} adds ${accounts.lstMint} to the Infinity pool, valued by the SOL value calculator program ${accounts.solValueCalculator}

display.intent: Remove an LST from the pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} removes ${accounts.lstMint} from the Infinity pool and sends the rent of its accounts to ${accounts.refundRentTo}

instructions.name: setSolValueCalculator
docs: After calcProgram, pass the new calculator's CPI accounts as remaining accounts.
The accounts the SOL value calculator program named before them takes.

display.intent: Set an LST's SOL value calculator
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} sets the SOL value calculator program of ${accounts.lstMint} to ${accounts.calcProgram}
${accounts.curr} hands the admin role of the Infinity pool to ${accounts.new}
${accounts.admin} sets the protocol fee of the Infinity pool to ${data.protocolFeeNanos}
${accounts.curr} makes ${accounts.new} the protocol fee beneficiary of the Infinity pool
${accounts.admin} sets the pricing program of the Infinity pool to ${accounts.new}
${accounts.beneficiary} withdraws ${data.amount} of ${accounts.lstMint} in protocol fees to ${accounts.withdrawTo}
${accounts.admin} lets ${accounts.new} disable the Infinity pool
${accounts.signer} removes ${accounts.remove} from the authorities that may disable the Infinity pool
${accounts.signer} disables the Infinity pool, stopping its swaps and liquidity changes
${accounts.admin} enables the Infinity pool again

instructions.name: startRebalance
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: outCalcProgram, output calculator CPI accounts, inpCalcProgram, input calculator CPI accounts.

The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the output LST's SOL value calculator accounts (outLstValueCalcAccs counts them with the program before them), then the input LST's SOL value calculator program and its accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.rebalanceAuth} takes ${data.amount} of ${accounts.outLstMint} out of the Infinity pool to ${accounts.withdrawTo} to rebalance it into ${accounts.inpLstMint}; a later instruction of the transaction must end the rebalance

instructions.name: endRebalance
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: inpCalcProgram, input calculator CPI accounts.
The accounts the SOL value calculator program named before them takes.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.rebalanceAuth} ends the rebalance of the Infinity pool into ${accounts.inpLstMint}; the program fails it if the pool lost SOL value
${accounts.signer} makes ${accounts.new} the rebalance authority of the Infinity pool

instructions.name: swapExactInV2
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: inpCalcProgram, inp calculator CPI accounts, outCalcProgram, out calculator CPI accounts, pricingProgram, pricing CPI accounts.

The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the input LST's SOL value calculator accounts (as many as inpLstValueCalcAccs counts, less the program before them), the output LST's SOL value calculator program and its accounts (outLstValueCalcAccs counts both), then the pool's pricing program and its accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} swaps ${data.amount} of ${accounts.inpMint} from ${accounts.inpAcc} for at least ${data.limit} of ${accounts.outMint} to ${accounts.outAcc} through the Infinity pool

instructions.name: swapExactOutV2
docs: Dynamic trailing CPI account groups are interleaved on chain as: inpCalcProgram, inp calculator CPI accounts, outCalcProgram, out calculator CPI accounts, pricingProgram, pricing CPI accounts.

The rest of the CPI accounts, in order: the input LST's SOL value calculator accounts (as many as inpLstValueCalcAccs counts, less the program before them), the output LST's SOL value calculator program and its accounts (outLstValueCalcAccs counts both), then the pool's pricing program and its accounts.

display.intent: Swap for an exact amount out
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} swaps at most ${data.limit} of ${accounts.inpMint} from ${accounts.inpAcc} for ${data.amount} of ${accounts.outMint} to ${accounts.outAcc} through the Infinity pool
${accounts.beneficiary} withdraws the Infinity pool's accrued protocol fees as ${accounts.infMint} to ${accounts.withdrawTo}

instructions.name: setRps
docs: The rps argument is the raw UQ0F63-backed u64 stored on chain.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.rpsAuth} sets the share of withheld yield the Infinity pool releases each slot to ${data.rps} (a fraction of 2^63)
${accounts.signer} makes ${accounts.newRpsAuth} the authority that sets the yield release rate of the Infinity pool
